name: Camp Glaspond
summary:
Camp Glaspond, the site of a brutal massacre of which you are the only survivor.

It's been twenty years, and now you're taking your daughter Madison to nursing school.

Haunted by the events of the past, you find yourself stumbling to consciousness, your wrecked car several feet away. Madison is nowhere to be found.

In the distance lurks a familiar place, one you thought you had left behind.

Camp Glaspond.
